headline: FW_v14.2.109_RC3: health index 63.2/100 (RED), +8.5 vs FW_v14.2.107_RC2.
Pass rate 96.38% across 6,000 HCI + phone tests (163 failed, 54 blocked), +0.45 pts vs previous build.
Full cycle took 7.47 days (179.3 h), +11.3 h over the 7-day baseline due to failure re-runs; critical path HCI_REGRESSION.
MTBF 160.0 h per DUT with 12 crashes (3 unique signatures); 1 Blocker and 6 Critical Jiras open.
KPI breaches: A2DP_Latency_ms 124.3 vs target < 100 (FAIL), A2DP_Dropouts_per_hr 1.209 vs target < 1.0 (FAIL).

actions.action: Fix BTFW-4012 (LC3 codec frame buffer NULL dereference on CIS re-establishment) immediately to unblock 46 blocked tests (41 LE_Audio_CIS_BIS, 5 LE_Audio_Unicast); clear 13 failing tests (9 LE_Audio_CIS_BIS, 4 LE_Audio_Unicast); eliminate 7 MTBF crashes on DUT-02, DUT-05, DUT-14.
actions.rationale: Blocker, open 7 build(s), required by: Blocker gate. Verify with RS-01 (93 tests, ~24 h) instead of a full cycle.

actions.action: Hold the release: 5 of 5 gates failing (Open Blocker Jiras, Open Critical Jiras, Overall pass rate %, MTBF hours per DUT, KPI metrics passing). Projected ready 2026-11-12 vs target 2026-11-10 (AT_RISK, +2.2 days).

Fix BTFW-4031 (Scheduler starves ISO events when A2DP ACL and LE Audio CIS run concurrently) to clear 34 failing tests (18 LE_Audio_CIS_BIS, 6 LE_Audio_Unicast, 4 LE_Audio_Broadcast, 3 SCO_eSCO, 3 A2DP_Streaming); bring A2DP_Latency_ms back within target (124.3 vs < 100); bring A2DP_Dropouts_per_hr back within target (1.209 vs < 1.0).
actions.rationale: Critical, open 4 build(s), required by: Critical gate. Verify with RS-02 (99 tests, ~8 h) instead of a full cycle.

actions.action: Inspect DUT-02 (EVT2 board, RF lot LOT-A17) and swap it for a DVT1 board in the next MTBF run to separate hardware from firmware causes.
actions.rationale: DUT-02 crashed 45 times across 8 builds: 3.2x the fleet median (14) and 11.2x DUT-16 (4). Board EVT2, RF lot LOT-A17.

actions.action: Run targeted subset RS-08 on the next build (619 tests, ~24 h, 86.6% shorter than the 179.3 h full cycle). Keep the full cycle for the final release candidate.
actions.rationale: Every open failure, blocked test and feature gating test is covered; MTBF soak on DUTs that crashed.
